intended_behavior: Add new methods to the Review class to implement an explicit 'code review' step and automated self-healing. These methods should: Request from the LLM a set of QA tasks based on the project specification; Inspect the generated code to see if it is expected to pass each QA task; Generate fixing code blocks that overwrite files to correct any identified issues. This expands the Review class functionality while preserving its existing role as a container for review metadata.

Add or extend functions to create AI prompts specifically targeting the review and self-healing tasks. These functions should: Generate prompt text to ask the LLM for QA tasks; Prompt the LLM to analyze generated code for QA pass/fail evaluation; Generate code fix prompts for self-healing if problems are detected. These prompt functions must integrate cleanly with existing prompt construction, supporting the new review workflow without impacting existing generation flows.
